# [Virtualmin Podman module 2.2.0 released](https://forum.virtualmin.com/t/virtualmin-podman-module-2-2-0-released/138292)


[News](https://forum.virtualmin.com/c/news/5)


[pro-only](https://forum.virtualmin.com/tag/pro-only)


[Ilia](https://forum.virtualmin.com/u/Ilia)


November 7, 2026, 12:17am 1


Howdy all,


We’ve rolled out Virtualmin Podman 2.2.0 to all Virtualmin repos.


Changes since Virtualmin Podman 2.1.0:


- Add a NetBox recipe with a private PostgreSQL database, Valkey services and a background worker
- Add an optional container user for rootless recipes, container forms and CLI commands
- Add per-service image pull policies to Compose imports
- Fix existing file bind mounts failing during Compose imports and container or pod creation
- Fix recipe image updates reporting completion before the web application is ready


---


As always, if you run into any problems, let us know in a *new* topic.
